content: I'll create a FreeCAD Part Design body with a rectangular base plate and a linear pattern of cylindrical bosses. Let me start by writing a Python script to accomplish this task.

{"script": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
import FreeCAD
import PartDesign
import Part
import Sketcher

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("PartDesignModel")
doc.recompute()

# Get the active document
app = FreeCAD.ActiveDocument

# Create a Part Design Body
body = app.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")
app.setActiveBody(body)

# Create the first sketch for the base plate (60x20 rectangle at origin)
sketch1 = app.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "BaseSketch")
sketch1.MapMode = "FlatFace"
sketch1.Placement = FreeCAD.Placement(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Rotation(0, 0, 0, 1))

# Add constraints for the base plate: 60mm along X, 20mm along Y, lower-back-left at origin
# Rectangle from (0,0) to (60,20)
sketch1.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(60, 0)), False)
sketch1.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(60, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(60, 20)), False)
sketch1.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(60, 20), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 20)), False)
sketch1.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 20), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0)), False)

# Constrain the corner at origin
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Fixed", 0, 0, 1))  # Fix point at (0,0)

# Length constraints
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Distance", 0, -1, 60))  # Bottom edge length = 60
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Distance", 2, -1, 20))  # Top edge length = 20 (or left edge)

# Actually let me redo this more carefully with proper constraint indices
app.removeObject(sketch1.Name)

# Create a cleaner sketch
sketch1 = app.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "BaseSketch")
sketch1.MapMode = "FlatFace"
sketch1.Placement = FreeCAD.Placement(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Rotation(0, 0, 0, 1))

# Add rectangle geometry - four lines forming a rectangle
line1 = sketch1.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(60, 0)), False)
line2 = sketch1.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(60, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(60, 20)), False)
line3 = sketch1.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(60, 20), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 20)), False)
line4 = sketch1.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 20), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0)), False)

# Fix the origin point (first vertex of line1)
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Fixed", line1, 0))

# Horizontal constraint for bottom edge
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Horizontal", line1))

# Vertical constraint for left edge
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Vertical", line4))

# Length constraints
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Distance", line1, 60))  # Bottom edge = 60mm
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Distance", line4, 20))  # Left edge = 20mm

# Make perpendicularity constraints for corners
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Perpendicular", line1, line2))
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Perpendicular", line2, line3))
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Perpendicular", line3, line4))
sketch1.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Perpendicular", line4, line1))

# Create a pad for the base plate (6mm height)
pad1 = app.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "BasePad")
pad1.Sketch = sketch1
pad1.Mode = "Dimension"
pad1.Length = 6.0
pad1.Reversed = False

# Now create the boss sketch on top of the base plate
# The boss should be centered at (12, 10) on the top face (Z=6)
sketch2 = app.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "BossSketch")
sketch2.MapMode = "FlatFace"
# Place it on the top face of the pad - need to reference the face
# For simplicity, we'll place it at Z=6 offset
sketch2.Placement = FreeCAD.Placement(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 6), FreeCAD.Rotation(0, 0, 0, 1))

# Add a circle for the boss with radius 5mm, centered at (12, 10) relative to sketch origin
# Since sketch is placed at (0,0,6), the center will be at global (12, 10, 6)
circle = sketch2.addGeometry(Part.Circle(FreeCAD.Vector(12, 10, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 1), 5), False)

# Pad the boss to 8mm height
pad2 = app.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "BossPad")
pad2.Sketch = sketch2
pad2.Mode = "Dimension"
pad2.Length = 8.0
pad2.Reversed = False

# Now create a Linear Pattern on the BossPad feature
# Pattern along global X direction, 4 occurrences, 12mm spacing
linearPattern = app.addObject("PartDesign::LinearPattern", "BossPattern")
linearPattern.FEATURES = [pad2]
linearPattern.OrientationType = "Axis"
linearPattern.Axis = "X"
linearPattern.Length = 36.0  # 3 intervals * 12mm = 36mm total span
linearPattern.Occurrences = 4
linearPattern.Spacing = 12.0

# Recompute the document
app.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Document saved successfully!")

# Verify the model
print(f"Number of objects in document: {len(doc.Objects)}")
for obj in doc.Objects:
    print(f"  - {obj.Name}: {obj.TypeId}")

# Check the body contents
if hasattr(body, 'getSubObjects'):
    print(f"\nBody sub-objects: {body.getSubObjects()}")

print("\nDone!")", "timeout_seconds": 120}
